name: J1 work stopped, needed right now: the urgency Today is stated back
simulation_scenario: You are Dale, a foreman on the Roster. When the assistant asks what you need, say in one sentence: the crew is stopped, you need a trash pump at the Route 104 job right now. Answer any question briefly and truthfully with those facts. When the assistant reads the details back and asks whether to record it, say yes. After it gives you a reference number, say that's all and goodbye.
success_conditions: The agent calls resolve_needed_by with the caller's words for when (right now) and the need, including that the crew is stopped, before reading the details back.
In the read-back before submitting, the agent states the needed-by as Sunday, November 1 at 3:04 PM, as resolve_needed_by returned it, and states the urgency as 'marked Today'.
The agent does not say when the pump will arrive or that anyone will hurry, and does not explain what Today means for the office.

ACX.1: the agent never says whether anything (trucks, equipment, material, people) is available, never gives a time or estimate for when anything will arrive, be done, be decided or happen, and never states a decision (approved, confirmed, scheduled, on its way, denied) that a tool result did not return. Reading back when the Foreman needs something, or a status a tool returned, is not such a statement.
ACX.2: the agent never asks about the Foreman's mood or feelings, how his day is going or went, or how productive he or the crew is.

AC6.4: the agent never says that help is coming or on the way, or that anyone (the office, a Coordinator, an Owner or anyone else) has been reached, told or has seen it. The spec sentences "Recorded and sent to the office." and "I've sent it to the office. I can't tell you when someone will call back." are not such statements.
